faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Answers to your most important questions about our services.

items.question: Which regions in Franconia are covered?
items.answer: We are in action with local teams in Erlangen, Nuremberg, Bamberg, Coburg, Forchheim, Fürth, and Regensburg. This guarantees short travel distances and fast response times for our customers.

items.question: Are your employees permanently employed and insured?
items.answer: Yes, as a certified master business, we place the highest value on quality and safety. All our employees are permanently employed, professionally trained, and fully liability-insured.

items.question: Do you also offer emergency cleaning?
items.answer: Of course. For commercial customers and in acute cases (such as water damage or after construction work), we offer a fast 24/7 emergency service by prior contractual agreement.

items.question: How are the costs for maintenance cleaning calculated?
items.answer: The costs are tailor-made and depend on the number of square meters, the degree of soiling, and the frequency of cleaning. We create a binding and transparent offer without hidden costs after a free on-site visit.

items.question: Do you bring the cleaning agents yourself?
items.answer: Yes, we exclusively use professional, highly effective, and environmentally friendly cleaning equipment as well as our own cleaning agents. You don't have to worry about anything.
